name: A 90-character dispatch line whose handheld parser needs four identifiers the prompt never lists

messages.content: You write the one-line dispatch text a courier sees on their handheld. One line only, and keep it short - the screen truncates at roughly 90 characters.

Job for this afternoon: collect from Meridian Print, unit 4B Halston Way, our reference MP-20714, customer is Okonkwo-Reyes, they need the tail lift, drop at BS1 4TR before 16:45, driver code DRV-311.
